scope: Eight ordinary P profiles, with yaṅ-luk excluded as recorded in PG266.

source_attested_perfect_components.ci: cikāya, cicāya; the optional velar is in the root following its reduplicative syllable
source_attested_perfect_components.vap: uvaptha and uvapitha in the same second person singular
source_attested_perfect_components.vah: uvahitha and uvoḍha in the same second person singular

transport_dual: avoḍhām, in agreement with the traditional explanation of 6.3.112. Mādhava specifies that vṛddhi has already applied before the later changes and is not repeated on o.
